name: wishlist-agent-plugin-tooling
description: Checks for the wishlist agent plugin package (manifests, README, release). Not published; the plugin itself has no code.

scripts.validate:claude: claude plugin validate --strict ./plugin && claude plugin validate --strict ./plugin-en && claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
